CustomField.description: Field is for BasicGov Reporting requirements
CustomField.formula: Text(Year(Date__c)) & "-" & IF(Len(TEXT(Month(Date__c)))=1, "0" & TEXT(Month(Date__c)), TEXT(Month(Date__c))) & "-" & IF(LEN(TEXT(Day(Date__c)))=1, "0" & TEXT(Day(Date__c)), TEXT(Day(Date__c)))
